people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
translations.bsb: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
translations.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
